How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Warangal Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Warangal JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Warangal is 31 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering/Production/Manufacturing/Aerospace Engineering with first class, or an ME/MTech in Manufacturing/Computer Integrated/Materials science/Production/CAD CAM/Design with first class.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow position is Rs. 37,000 + HRA per month for candidates with GATE qualification, and Rs. 31,000 + HRA per month for those without GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NIT Warangal JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email by sending their resume and required documents to the official email address specified in the notification. The application must be submitted before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will involve an interview, which can be conducted either online or offline.

faq.question: Q8. Which department is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the National Institute of Technology Warangal (NIT Warangal).

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. Where is NIT Warangal located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Warangal is located in Warangal, Telangana, with the pincode 506004.
